Source: https://github.com/dashersw/liquid-glass-js
Pinned commit: 78cb6ccb0b9987bb60a88b14ccbd13a9e6e8ab2a
MIT license retained in LICENSE. Modifications: ESM default export and removal of trailing whitespace.

The map enhancement shares one upstream Container WebGL shader across map overlays,
with passive 2D canvases for presentation. The adapter replaces whole-document
html2canvas capture with visible CORS-enabled Leaflet tiles, owns lifecycle and
disposal, and uploads one shared snapshot per update. No account text, user
photos or report evidence is captured. Other routes use native CSS frosted
materials, preserving dense reading surfaces and semantic colors. No captures
are uploaded anywhere. Native CSS is the fallback when WebGL is unavailable or transparency is reduced.
